audit_metadata.scope: Downstream WCD9378 logic characterization and upstream-equivalent candidate mapping

missing.impact: Regulator behavior is embedded in main codec file and vendor helper stack; no dedicated regulator module exists.

major_subsystems.summary: Large SDCA-oriented register space with explicit analog/TX/RX/MBHC/ClassH groups and SDCA function/register windows.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Declares `WCD9378_BASE`, register addressing macro, and function/analog base regions.
Shows RX/ClassH/MBHC/aux register domains, confirming broad functional coverage.
Regmap config binds default table and max register to the register map model.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: wcd937x.h + wcd937x-sdw.c register model with Linux regmap/soundwire APIs

major_subsystems.summary: Vendor supply model (`msm_cdc_*`, `cdc_regulator`) is used instead of upstream regulator bulk APIs.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Includes vendor supply/pinctrl headers.
Uses `msm_cdc_get_power_supplies` and vendor supply description.
Uses `msm_cdc_init_supplies` instead of upstream regulator bulk APIs.
Upstream pattern uses named supplies with `devm_regulator_bulk_get_enable`.

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream reset is pinctrl-state driven via `qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node`; upstream expects `reset-gpios` + gpiod.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Parses `qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node` phandle from DT.
Reset sequence uses `msm_cdc_pinctrl_*` vendor APIs.
Upstream common binding requires `reset-gpios`.
Upstream codec obtains reset GPIO with `devm_gpiod_get`.

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream is legacy SWR-style (`wcd9378-slave`) with Qualcomm SWR bus APIs; upstream WCD uses Linux SDW IDs and APIs.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Defines slave id/compatible as `wcd9378-slave` / `qcom,wcd9378-slave`.
Creates regmap with downstream SWR helper `devm_regmap_init_swr`.
Uses `swr_get_logical_dev_num` and `swr_driver_register` flow.
Upstream SDW binding constrains compatible to `sdw20217010a00`.
Upstream pattern uses `devm_regmap_init_sdw` and SDW slave IDs (`SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY`).

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: wcd937x-sdw.c SDW slave implementation + qcom,wcd937x-sdw binding schema

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream explicitly enables paging and programs SDCA interrupt registers; regmap callbacks include SDCA ranges.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Sets `paging_support = true` on rx/tx slaves.
Writes SDCA intr type registers during bind.
Post-IRQ handler acknowledges/reads SDCA status registers via regmap.
Read/write/volatile callbacks explicitly include SDCA status/mask/type windows.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Linux SDW + regmap callbacks from wcd937x-sdw/wcd-common patterns (needs variant-specific validation)

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream integrates MBHC and Class-H with Qualcomm-specific wrappers and legacy Class-H API symbols.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Codec probe performs MBHC init and Class-H init.
Includes MBHC/ClassH headers and embeds class-h + mbhc structures in private state.
Local wrapper allocates/initializes MBHC using callback table and IRQ ids.
Upstream Class-H API surface is v2 control object based (`wcd_clsh_ctrl_*`).
Upstream MBHC model is shared and callback-driven.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Reuse shared `wcd-mbhc-v2` and `wcd-clsh-v2` with codec-specific callback tables

major_subsystems.summary: Codec exports a large topology surface with many controls/widgets/routes.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Control table declaration.
DAPM widget table declaration.
DAPM route table declaration.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Topology should be rebased against upstream WCD937x/WCD938x style and trimmed to evidence-backed behavior

major_subsystems.summary: Main codec and slave include multiple vendor-only frameworks, debug plumbing, and version guards.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Includes `linux/version.h`, `msm-cdc-*`, vendor binding headers, qti debugfs, bolero internal APIs.
Kernel-version guarded remove signature indicates downstream compatibility scaffolding.
Slave debugfs create paths (`swrslave_peek/poke/reg_dump`) are bring-up/debug oriented.
Global SDCA debugfs helper exposes direct register access.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Keep only generic kernel APIs and remove vendor debug/bind/version scaffolding

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream lifecycle uses component master + manual bind/unbind + system PM hooks; runtime PM/autosuspend shape differs from upstream WCD model.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Bind path performs slave bind, regmap/IRQ setup, and non-devm component registration.
System suspend/resume manipulates vendor supply state and bias flags.
Upstream pattern enables runtime PM autosuspend in probe/remove.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Rebase lifecycle on upstream WCD937x component + runtime PM structure

major_subsystems.summary: Machine driver includes explicit WCD9378 selection and MBHC hook paths, indicating board/platform coupling outside codec module.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Selects WCD9378 codec name and `get_dev_num` callback based on platform state.
Routes MBHC headset detection to `wcd9378_mbhc_hs_detect`.
Runtime component probing selects WCD9378 variant by available codec component.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Treat machine-level routing/selection as board integration, not core codec upstream requirement

major_subsystems.summary: Downstream build splits codec/slave modules and includes extra sdca helper object; upstream build uses `wcd937x` + `wcd937x-sdw` objects under one Kconfig family.

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Defines `CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD9378` and separate `CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD9378_SLAVE` object lists, including `sdca-registers-api.o`.
Upstream Kconfig exposes `SND_SOC_WCD937X` and `SND_SOC_WCD937X_SDW` only.
Upstream Makefile uses `wcd937x.o` and `wcd937x-sdw.o` object model.

major_subsystems.upstream_equivalent_candidate: Extend WCD937x Kconfig/OF/SDW matching carefully rather than importing downstream module split

evidence.why_it_supports_or_rejects: Only a one-page marketing/spec sheet; no WCD9378 register/probe/DT implementation guidance.
Content enumerates WCD9370/WCD9375 playback/record specs, not WCD9378 software integration requirements.
